argument: The archive must be carried by paired agent routes and their delayed rejoin, not by the detour cross, counters, or WebGPU label. Hide every witness and ask whether the crowd still opens and returns.

A caption-free viewer should find adjacent crowd strata fanning into near/far lanes around an encounter and drawing back together downstream. If it reads as luminous waves, the changed rule is not visible.
Pointer and Enter/Space must place the same bounded detour, while lifting the latest one must restore the exact prior agent field from both input paths.
A second route is an attractive metaphor. Delete v006 if the split only changes colour, if the paired lanes never rejoin, or if the prose explains more memory than the mass can show.
